reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
convert scalar aggregates to aggregated sums

WITH filtered_cd AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'M'
      AND cd_marital_status = 'W'
      AND cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
),
filtered_d AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1999
),
filtered_s AS (
    SELECT s_store_sk, s_state
    FROM store
    WHERE s_state IN ('TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN')
),
sales_agg AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        store_sales.ss_item_sk,
        filtered_s.s_state,
        SUM(store_sales.ss_quantity) AS quantity_sum,
        COUNT(store_sales.ss_quantity) AS quantity_cnt,
        SUM(store_sales.ss_list_price) AS list_price_sum,
        COUNT(store_sales.ss_list_price) AS list_price_cnt,
        SUM(store_sales.ss_coupon_amt) AS coupon_amt_sum,
        COUNT(store_sales.ss_coupon_amt) AS coupon_amt_cnt,
        SUM(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS sales_price_sum,
        COUNT(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS sales_price_cnt
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN filtered_cd ON store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk = filtered_cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN filtered_d ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = filtered_d.d_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_s ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = filtered_s.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY store_sales.ss_item_sk, filtered_s.s_state
)
SELECT
    item.i_item_id,
    sales_agg.s_state,
    GROUPING(sales_agg.s_state) AS g_state,
    SUM(sales_agg.quantity_sum)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(sales_agg.quantity_cnt), 0)::numeric AS agg1,
    SUM(sales_agg.list_price_sum)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(sales_agg.list_price_cnt), 0)::numeric AS agg2,
    SUM(sales_agg.coupon_amt_sum)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(sales_agg.coupon_amt_cnt), 0)::numeric AS agg3,
    SUM(sales_agg.sales_price_sum)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(sales_agg.sales_price_cnt), 0)::numeric AS agg4
FROM sales_agg
JOIN item ON sales_agg.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
GROUP BY ROLLUP (item.i_item_id, sales_agg.s_state)
ORDER BY item.i_item_id, sales_agg.s_state
LIMIT 100
